interface.longDescription: Work through a business decision using the Universal Decision-Making Method from Deciding by Roger Estall and Grant Purdy. Clarify your desired outcome, compare concrete options, examine assumptions and evidence, and judge sufficient certainty. Receive a complete Decision review in ChatGPT with your reasoning, unresolved questions, practical next steps and monitoring plans.
defaultPrompt: Help me work through a business decision, one useful question at a time.
Help me decide whether to proceed, change my plan or choose another option.
Review my decision reasoning and identify what evidence would change my mind.

name: the-walk-decide-better
description: A conversational business decision review using the Universal Decision-Making Method from Deciding by Roger Estall and Grant Purdy.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is completely free, with no payments or purchases. Its optional methodology link leads to sufficientcertainty.com, which separately offers paid products. No purchase or website visit is required to complete the review in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: ChatGPT adaptation of the publisher’s decision-coaching instructions. Complete Decision review in chat, methodology attribution, one-question coaching and optional methodology link. Skills-only; no MCP connection.
